LADI is a powerful and efficient instrument for neutron Laue crystallography.
the use of the LADI instrument for neutron Laue diffraction is a very efficient method for the collection of neutron-diffraction intensities from protein and nucleic-acid crystals.
the LADI experiment is a powerful tool for the determination of hydrogen and deutron positions in biological systems, even when the resolution is limited.
